beats.summary: Pam discusses her pregnancy and upcoming maternity leave.

evidence.snippet: Pam (on the phone with a client): I just wanted to check and see if there's anything you needed before I went on my maternity leave… Yeah, I'm pregnant…
Pam: No, no. I still have time.

beats.summary: Dwight protests Pam's maternity leave and discusses having a baby for business reasons.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Wait a minute! You can't do that. You cannot exploit your baby for sales.
Dwight: I need a baby. I'll never outsell Jim and Pam without one.

beats.summary: The group discusses labor, hospital plans, and timing for Pam's delivery.

evidence.snippet: Pam: I'm having contractions, but they're irregular and far apart. So I'm not really in labor, I'm near labor.
Jim: Yeah, we're slow-playing it because of our stupid HMO.

beats.summary: Dwight proposes to Angela to have a child for business reasons.

evidence.snippet: Dwight (with Angela in the break room): Bare my child.

beats.summary: Andy makes a joke about baby names and his brother.

evidence.snippet: Andy: My brother was born, and my parents felt he better exemplified the Walter Jr. name, so they gave it to him.

beats.summary: Michael offers to drive Pam and Jim to the hospital, but there are complications.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Oh, oh, oh! Contraption! She's contrapting! Okay, you know what? I think I should drive you guys to the hospital, and here is why.
Michael: Actually, I put diesel in this time, trying to save some money.
